name: json-render
one_liner: Lets an AI generate a working screen (buttons, cards, charts) on the fly from a written request, using only pre-approved building blocks so it can't break the app.
buyer: A product manager at a SaaS company who wants an 'ask for a custom dashboard view' AI feature without engineers hand-building every possible layout.
business_use_cases: A B2B analytics SaaS lets customers type 'show me revenue by region as a chart' and get a real, safe dashboard view generated on demand.
An internal-tools team lets non-technical staff request custom report views from an AI instead of filing tickets with engineering.
An agency builds one 'AI dashboard generator' product and resells it, white-labeled, to multiple small SaaS clients.

money_ideas.idea: Build a white-label 'AI-generated dashboard' add-on and license it to SaaS products that lack the engineering time to build one.
Offer implementation services adding generative-UI dashboards to existing client products.

steal_this: Build a small 'ask for a chart' generative-UI plugin for one popular no-code/analytics tool's ecosystem and sell it as an add-on this weekend.
